comment: The edge tests at luppolo.cpp:71 and :90 compare against the jack's own previous sample and require that previous sample to be exactly 0V, so a negative pulse triggers as readily as a positive one and a gate held above zero never re-triggers. The clear at luppolo.cpp:104 is a level rather than an edge. The loop is a std::vector grown one sample at a time with no cap (luppolo.cpp:116) and there is no dataToJson, so nothing survives a patch reload.
